question: In a basketball game, how many players from one team play on the court at any given time?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**5**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Basketball****​**

 
 
• It is a team game played on a rectangular court.
 
• It is played between two teams of 5 players each (excluding substitutes).
 
• It is played with the help of a **basketball** and a ring at 3.05 meters high.
 
• 
 
The game starts in** basketball**:

 
 
• starts with a jump ball.
 
• The official stand in the center circle with two players one each from both teams.
 
• After clearing all formalities, the referee tosses the ball up in the sky the team who catches the ball starts the game.
 
• 
 
Thus, the ball tossed in the central circle of the** basketball** playing field is called the jump ball.​​​​__​​​ 

 
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• **Basketball** court dimension:

 
 
• As per the International** Basketball **Federation/FIBA, the dimension of a regular basketball court is 28 by 15 meters.
 
• It should have a free area of 2 meters on each side which makes the required area for preparing a court 32 by 19 meters.
 
• Layup: It is a skill used by basketball players to score a basket.
 
• Pivoting: It is a defensive skill in basketball
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Football consists of 11-11 players in two teams. Each team consists of 11 players.
 
• In Kho-Kho each team consists of 12 players, but during a contest, only 9 players from each team take the field.
 
• Polo consists of 4 players. A Polo game is played on a large open field sitting on horses.
 
• Gymnastics consists of 7 players. There are 7 players in each team in the team competition.
